items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: why are you going to get a trombone player to play like Kid Ora?

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Were these New Orleans bands more popular than the Chicago bands? Yes. Do you think the people liked them better?

Yes. They could play, they could play better. No mistake about it, they could play better. There wasn't no Chicago band to equal Joe Otto's band. Nothing to even approach it. Now the musicians, why are you going to get a trombone player to play like Kid Ora?
